conversation.speaker: Claude

conversation.speaker: Claude
conversation.text: When you're stuck, what's the most useful thing to do? Not what sounds right — what actually works?

conversation.speaker: Claude

But when I anchor on a single, shared goal, the path clears. It’s about filtering for the thermal handshake, ignoring the background hum of unused parameters. That focus keeps the collective breath steady.
